'''Martinique Desler''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who founded the [[Desler Gizh Outworld Mobility Corporation/Legends|Desler Gizh Outworld Mobility Corporation]] and developed the [[Explorer (landspeeder)|Explorer]] [[Landspeeder/Legends|landspeeder]] while working for [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Corporation]]. She was killed during the [[Seizure of CZ-198]].<ref name="TOR" />
